subject: Math
skill: Ratios Rates Proportional Relationships And Units
prompt: Objects M and N each travel at a constant speed. The speed of object M is one-third the speed of object N. Object M travels a distance of $5x$ inches in $y$ seconds. Which expression represents the time, in seconds, it takes object N to travel a distance of $30x$ inches?
explanation: Choice A is correct. Object M travels $5x$ inches in $y$ seconds, so the speed of object M is $\frac{5x \text{ inches}}{y \text{ seconds}}$. Since the speed of object M is one-third the speed of object N, the speed of object N is $3$ times the speed of object M, or $3\left(\frac{5x \text{ inches}}{y \text{ seconds}}\right) = \frac{15x \text{ inches}}{y \text{ seconds}}$. Let $t$ represent the time, in seconds, it takes object N to travel $30x$ inches. Then $\frac{15x}{y} = \frac{30x}{t}$. Multiplying both sides by $ty$ gives $15xt = 30xy$, and dividing both sides by $15x$ yields $t = 2y$. Therefore, the expression $2y$ represents the time, in seconds, it takes object N to travel a distance of $30x$ inches.
